name: Stance of Power (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Tremorsense, Con 13

Benefit(s): If you can detect a creature with your tremorsense, you know how to set your stance against him so as to gain the maximum effect for your attacks and defense. You can add a +2 circumstance bonus to one of the following as an immediate action each round: your attack rolls, Armor Class, CMB or your CMD.
